# LeRobot MuJoCo Training ACT, SmolVLA, Pi0 Tutorial
This repository provides a minimal working example: it is used to collect teaching data and train (or fine-tune) the visual-language-action (VLA) model on a custom dataset.

## Installation
It passed the test on **Python 3.10**.

It is not recommended to use `pip install lerobot` directly, as it may cause errors.

Install MuJoCo dependencies and lerobot:
```bash
conda create -n py310 python=3.10
pip install -r requirements.txt
conda install jupyterlab
pip install ipywidgets ipykernel
python -m ipykernel install --user --name py310 --display-name "py310"
jupyter lab .
# 在当前目录启动


# 如果torch的cuda有问题：
pip uninstall -y torch torchvision torchaudio
pip install --no-cache-dir --force-reinstall --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 torch==2.6.0 torchvision==0.21.0 torchaudio==2.6.0
python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda, torch.cuda.is_available())"


```

Please confirm that the MuJoCo version is **3.1.6**.

Unzip resource files:
```bash
cd asset/objaverse
unzip plate_11.zip
```

## 1. Collect teaching data
Run [1.collect_data.ipynb](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/1.collect_data.ipynb)

Collects teaching data in the given environment. The task is to pick up the cup and place it on the plate. When the cup is on the plate, the gripper is open, and the end effector is positioned above the cup, the environment determines success.

<img src="../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/media/teleop.gif" width="480" height="360">

Key position descriptions:
- `WASD`: movement in the x-y plane
- `R/F`: z-axis movement
- `Q/E`: tilt
- `方向键`: remaining rotation
- `空格`: switch gripper state
- `Z`: reset the environment and discard the current round cache data

Overlaid image descriptions:
- Top right: Agent's perspective
- Bottom right: Wrist (first-person) perspective
- Top left: Side view
- Bottom left: Top view

Dataset structure:
```python
fps = 20,
features={
    "observation.image": {
        "dtype": "image",
        "shape": (256, 256, 3),
        "names": ["height", "width", "channels"],
    },
    "observation.wrist_image": {
        "dtype": "image",
        "shape": (256, 256, 3),
        "names": ["height", "width", "channel"],
    },
    "observation.state": {
        "dtype": "float32",
        "shape": (6,),
        "names": ["state"], # x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw
    },
    "action": {
        "dtype": "float32",
        "shape": (7,),
        "names": ["action"], # 6 个关节角 + 1 个夹爪
    },
    "obj_init": {
        "dtype": "float32",
        "shape": (6,),
        "names": ["obj_init"], # 仅物体初始位置，训练中不使用
    },
},
```

Data is stored in the `./demo_data` directory by default. Example data is provided in the repository: [demo_data_example](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/demo_data_example).

## 3. Train Action-Chunking-Transformer (ACT)
Run [3.train.ipynb](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/3.train.ipynb)

**It takes about 30~60 minutes**.

Train ACT on a custom dataset. In the example `chunk_size=10`.

The trained checkpoint will be saved in `./ckpt/act_y`.

The policy error can be evaluated by comparing it with the true value action of the dataset.

<image src="../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/media/inference.png"  width="480" height="360">

<details>
    <summary>PicklingError: Can't pickle &lt;function &lt;lambda&gt;&gt;...&gt;</summary>

If a pickling error occurs, set `num_workers` to `0`. For example:

```python
dataloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(
    dataset,
    num_workers=0, # 4
    batch_size=64,
    shuffle=True,
    pin_memory=device.type != "cpu",
    drop_last=True,
)
```
</details>

## Models and Dataset
### Obtain language condition dataset

Pi0 and SmolVLA use the same language condition data. Choose one of the following methods. All commands are run in the chapter directory, and the data is stored uniformly in `./demo_data_language`.

**Method 1: Download the public sample**

[Datawhale Public Example](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datawhale/datawhale_eai_pnp_language) is the LeRobot v2.1 dataset for the OMY scenario, containing 20 episodes and 2621 frames, along with two tasks: red cup and blue cup.

First, install Git LFS, and then execute:

```bash
git lfs install
git clone https://huggingface.co/datasets/Datawhale/datawhale_eai_pnp_language demo_data_language
git -C demo_data_language lfs pull
```

Do not clone or delete the original data if there is already a directory with the same name. If the directory is a Git repository for this dataset, you can directly execute the last command to populate the LFS files. Downloading only the LFS pointer files does not mean that the data is complete.

**Method 2: Self-collection**

Run [5.language_env.ipynb](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/5.language_env.ipynb), keep `REPO_NAME = 'datawhale_eai_pnp_language'` and `ROOT = "./demo_data_language"`, collect and save the red and blue cup demonstrations, and then use [6.visualize_data.ipynb](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/6.visualize_data.ipynb) to check the trajectory. This Notebook includes a confirmation step for deleting old data when the directory already exists; if data has been downloaded or demonstrations have been performed, you should back up or change the directory first.

Both methods can use `pi0_datawhale_eai.yaml` and `smolvla_datawhale_eai.yaml` from this chapter without changing the configuration:

```yaml
dataset:
  repo_id: datawhale_eai_pnp_language
  root: ./demo_data_language
```

`root` is the local data path relative to the execution directory; when the complete dataset exists in this directory, the fixed version of LeRobot uses local files. `repo_id` is the dataset identifier. The values without the organization name follow the naming convention used in the collection Notebook and cannot be used as a searchable Hugging Face full address. When the full ID `Datawhale/datawhale_eai_pnp_language` needs to be automatically retrieved from the Hub, it should be used. When the local directory is changed, the paths in the YAML and deployment Notebook must also be updated accordingly.

## 7. Training and deployment of pi_0

The following commands are executed in the chapter directory, using the fixed LeRobot `10b7b3532543b4adfb65760f02a49b4c537afde7` with `requirements.txt`.
First, execute `python check_training_configs.py` to check two configurations (no training, no weight download).
In the YAML command, spaces are retained between `--config_path` and file names; the equal sign notation of this version will follow the JSON checkpoint loading branch.

- [train_model.py](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/train_model.py): Training script
- [pi0_datawhale_eai.yaml](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/pi0_datawhale_eai.yaml): Training configuration
- [7.pi0.ipynb](../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/7.pi0.ipynb): Deployment example

Training command:
```bash
python train_model.py --config_path pi0_datawhale_eai.yaml
```

Deployment effect:

<img src="../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/media/rollout2.gif" width="480" height="360" controls></img>

Training log:

<image src="../../../../06-策略抓取或抓取VLA/大模型控制、VLA、VLM/04mujoco复现ACT、Pi0、SmolVLA/media/wandb.png"  width="480" height="360">

The configuration should follow the YAML format linked in this section. By default, `./demo_data_language` from Section 5 is read, and `dataset.repo_id` corresponds to `datawhale_eai_pnp_language`. When using other data, both items need to be modified simultaneously. W&B is turned off by default; set your own project and account before enabling it. Training requires complete data, model weights, and a CUDA environment; the configuration parsing does not indicate that the full training has been verified.
